package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * What a cardio workout is done on (KAN-936 design §9, §11): the [kinds] a workout of it may be
 * labelled with, in §9's order with Custom last, and the target [metrics] its steps may carry —
 * both the backend's `CardioActivity` sets verbatim. [label] is the picker's name, [withArticle] the
 * form the shorthand's error copy reads ("incline isn't a target on an outdoor run").
 */
@Serializable
enum class CardioActivity(
    val label: String,
    val withArticle: String,
    val kinds: List<CardioKind>,
    val metrics: Set<CardioMetric>,
) {
    OUTDOOR_RUN(
        "Outdoor run",
        "an outdoor run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE, CardioMetric.CADENCE),
    ),
    TREADMILL_RUN(
        "Treadmill run",
        "a treadmill run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    OUTDOOR_RIDE(
        "Outdoor ride",
        "an outdoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    INDOOR_RIDE(
        "Indoor ride",
        "an indoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ELLIPTICAL(
        "Elliptical",
        "an elliptical",
        listOf(CardioKind.STEADY, CardioKind.INTERVALS, CardioKind.HILLS, CardioKind.CUSTOM),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),

    /** Metric whatever the workout's unit: pace per 500 m, every distance in metres (KAN-936 `rower-is-metric`). */
    ROWER(
        "Rower",
        "a rower",
        listOf(
            CardioKind.STEADY_STATE,
            CardioKind.INTERVALS,
            CardioKind.PYRAMID,
            CardioKind.SPRINTS,
            CardioKind.TEST_2K,
            CardioKind.CUSTOM,
        ),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ;

    val isRide: Boolean get() = this == OUTDOOR_RIDE || this == INDOOR_RIDE
}

private fun runKinds() =
    listOf(
        CardioKind.EASY,
        CardioKind.RECOVERY,
        CardioKind.LONG,
        CardioKind.TEMPO,
        CardioKind.INTERVALS,
        CardioKind.FARTLEK,
        CardioKind.HILLS,
        CardioKind.PROGRESSION,
        CardioKind.RACE,
        CardioKind.CUSTOM,
    )

private fun rideKinds() =
    listOf(
        CardioKind.ENDURANCE,
        CardioKind.RECOVERY,
        CardioKind.TEMPO,
        CardioKind.SWEET_SPOT,
        CardioKind.THRESHOLD,
        CardioKind.VO2_MAX,
        CardioKind.SPRINTS,
        CardioKind.CLIMBS,
        CardioKind.CADENCE_DRILLS,
        CardioKind.CUSTOM,
    )

enum class CardioKind(
    val label: String,
) {
    EASY("Easy"),
    RECOVERY("Recovery"),
    LONG("Long"),
    TEMPO("Tempo"),
    INTERVALS("Intervals"),
    FARTLEK("Fartlek"),
    HILLS("Hills"),
    PROGRESSION("Progression"),
    RACE("Race"),
    ENDURANCE("Endurance"),
    SWEET_SPOT("Sweet spot"),
    THRESHOLD("Threshold"),
    VO2_MAX("VO2 max"),
    SPRINTS("Sprints"),
    CLIMBS("Climbs"),
    CADENCE_DRILLS("Cadence drills"),
    STEADY("Steady"),
    STEADY_STATE("Steady state"),
    PYRAMID("Pyramid"),
    TEST_2K("2k test"),
    CUSTOM("Custom"),
}

/** A step target's metric, in the backend's order — the order a step's targets are parsed and printed in. */
@Serializable
enum class CardioMetric {
    PACE,
    SPEED,
    HEART_RATE,
    POWER,
    CADENCE,
    INCLINE,
    RESISTANCE,
}

@Serializable
enum class CardioStepType {
    WARM_UP,
    WORK,
    RECOVER,
    REST,
    COOL_DOWN,
}

/** A distance's own unit (KAN-936 `numbers-stored-as-typed`); a workout's unit is [KM] or [MI]. */
@Serializable
enum class DistanceUnit(
    val metres: Double,
) {
    M(1.0),
    KM(1000.0),
    MI(1609.344),
}

package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import com.gymie.shared.cardio.shorthand.clock
import com.gymie.shared.cardio.shorthand.hourClock
import com.gymie.shared.cardio.shorthand.number
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

private const val MINUTE = 60
private const val HOUR = 3600
private const val ROWER_PACE_METRES = 500.0
private const val TOTAL_DECIMALS = 1
private const val LOGGED_DECIMALS = 2
private const val TEN = 10.0

/**
 * A cardio workout's numbers in its distance unit (`cardio-ui` R7, KAN-936 §8): km / mi, pace per km /
 * per mi, km/h / mph, m / ft — and a rower in metres, its pace per 500 m, whatever the unit.
 */
object CardioFormat {
    /** A logged distance, two decimals as L2 draws ("5.02 km"); a rower's in whole metres. */
    fun distance(
        distance: CardioDistance,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(distance.value * distance.unit.metres, activity, units, LOGGED_DECIMALS)

    /** A plan's total, one decimal ("4.8 km"). */
    fun totalDistance(
        metres: Double,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(metres, activity, units, TOTAL_DECIMALS)

    fun pace(
        seconds: Int,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "${clock(seconds)} /" + if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "500 m" else unitName(units)

    fun speed(
        value: Double,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = fixed(value, TOTAL_DECIMALS) + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) " mph" else " km/h"

    fun elevation(
        value: Int,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "$value " + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "ft" else "m"

    /** A step's length in words: `open`, `800 m`, `45 s` under a minute, else as [duration] reads it. */
    fun length(length: CardioLength): String =
        when (length) {
            CardioLength.Open -> {
                "open"
            }

            is CardioLength.Of -> {
                number(length.distance.value) + " " +
                    length.distance.unit.name
                        .lowercase()
            }

            is CardioLength.Time -> {
                if (length.seconds < MINUTE) "${length.seconds} s" else duration(length.seconds)
            }
        }

    /** A total time: whole minutes "32 min", else "2:40", and "1:05:30" from an hour up. */
    fun duration(seconds: Int): String =
        when {
            seconds % MINUTE == 0 -> "${seconds / MINUTE} min"
            seconds < HOUR -> clock(seconds)
            else -> hourClock(seconds)
        }

    /** Duration ÷ distance in the pace basis, to the second — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedPace(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Int?,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Int? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || distance == null || distance.value <= 0) return null
        val basis = if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) ROWER_PACE_METRES else units.metres
        return (durationSeconds / (distance.value * distance.unit.metres / basis)).roundToInt()
    }

    /** Distance ÷ duration in km/h or mph, one decimal — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedSpeed(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Double?,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Double? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || durationSeconds <= 0 || distance == null) return null
        val perHour = distance.value * distance.unit.metres / units.metres / durationSeconds * HOUR
        return (perHour * TEN).roundToLong() / TEN
    }
}

private fun metres(
    metres: Double,
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
    decimals: Int,
): String =
    if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) {
        "${metres.roundToLong()} m"
    } else {
        fixed(metres / units.metres, decimals) + " " + unitName(units)
    }

private fun unitName(units: DistanceUnit) = if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mi" else "km"

/** [value] to exactly [decimals] places. */
private fun fixed(
    value: Double,
    decimals: Int,
): String {
    val scaled = (value * TEN.pow(decimals)).roundToLong().toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0')
    return scaled.dropLast(decimals) + "." + scaled.takeLast(decimals)
}

/**
 * The unit a target in [this] metric reads in, shared by the builder's rows and its step sheet; null for
 * incline and resistance, which each draw their own.
 */
internal fun CardioMetric.unitLabel(
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
): String? =
    when (this) {
        CardioMetric.PACE -> if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "/500 m" else "/${units.name.lowercase()}"
        CardioMetric.SPEED -> if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mph" else "km/h"
        CardioMetric.HEART_RATE -> "bpm"
        CardioMetric.POWER -> "W"
        CardioMetric.CADENCE -> if (activity.isRide) "rpm" else "spm"
        CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE -> null
    }

    fun length(length: CardioLength): String =
        when (length) {
            CardioLength.Open -> {
                "open"
            }

            is CardioLength.Of -> {
                number(length.distance.value) + " " +
                    length.distance.unit.name
                        .lowercase()
            }

            is CardioLength.Time -> {
                if (length.seconds < MINUTE) "${length.seconds} s" else duration(length.seconds)
            }
        }

    fun duration(seconds: Int): String =
        when {
            seconds % MINUTE == 0 -> "${seconds / MINUTE} min"
            seconds < HOUR -> clock(seconds)
            else -> hourClock(seconds)
        }

    /** Duration ÷ distance in the pace basis, to the second — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedPace(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Int?,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Int? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || distance == null || distance.value <= 0) return null
        val basis = if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) ROWER_PACE_METRES else units.metres
        return (durationSeconds / (distance.value * distance.unit.metres / basis)).roundToInt()
    }

    /** Distance ÷ duration in km/h or mph, one decimal — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedSpeed(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Double?,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Double? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || durationSeconds <= 0 || distance == null) return null
        val perHour = distance.value * distance.unit.metres / units.metres / durationSeconds * HOUR
        return (perHour * TEN).roundToLong() / TEN
    }
}

private fun metres(
    metres: Double,
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
    decimals: Int,
): String =
    if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) {
        "${metres.roundToLong()} m"
    } else {
        fixed(metres / units.metres, decimals) + " " + unitName(units)
    }

private fun unitName(units: DistanceUnit) = if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mi" else "km"

/** [value] to exactly [decimals] places. */
private fun fixed(
    value: Double,
    decimals: Int,
): String {
    val scaled = (value * TEN.pow(decimals)).roundToLong().toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0')
    return scaled.dropLast(decimals) + "." + scaled.takeLast(decimals)
}

    units: DistanceUnit,
): String? =

        CardioMetric.HEART_RATE -> "bpm"
        CardioMetric.POWER -> "W"

package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import com.gymie.shared.cardio.CardioLogField.AVG_CADENCE

import com.gymie.shared.domain.WorkoutStatus
import kotlinx.datetime.LocalDate
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNull
import kotlin.time.Instant

class CardioLogDraftTest {
    private val km = DistanceUnit.KM

    private fun workout(
        activity: CardioActivity,
        unit: DistanceUnit = km,
        status: WorkoutStatus = WorkoutStatus.PLANNED,
        startedAt: Instant? = null,
        log: CardioLog? = null,
        notes: String? = null,
    ) = CardioWorkout(
        id = "w1",
        scheduledDate = LocalDate(2026, 10, 16),
        displayName = "Session",
        notes = notes,
        status = status,
        startedAt = startedAt,
        activity = activity,
        kind = activity.kinds.first(),
        distanceUnit = unit,
        log = log,
    )

    private fun draftOf(
        activity: CardioActivity,
        unit: DistanceUnit = km,
    ) = CardioLogDraft.fresh(workout(activity, unit), Instant.parse("2026-10-16T19:12:06.900Z"))

    @Test
    fun durationReadsHoursMinutesAndSeconds() {
        val draft = draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)

        assertEquals(1992, draft.with(DURATION, "33:12").toRequest().durationSeconds)
        assertEquals(4360, draft.with(DURATION, "1:12:40").toRequest().durationSeconds)
    }

    @Test
    fun durationRefusesOtherShapes() {
        val draft = draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)

        listOf("45", "1:75", "abc").forEach { typed ->
            assertEquals("use h:mm:ss", draft.with(DURATION, typed).errors()[DURATION], typed)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun paceIsDerivedWhenBlankAndNeverSent() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)
                .with(DURATION, "33:12")
                .with(DISTANCE, "5.02")

        assertEquals("6:37", draft.derived(AVG_PACE))
        assertNull(draft.toRequest().avgPaceSeconds)
    }

    @Test
    fun speedIsDerivedForRides() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RIDE)
                .with(DURATION, "1:12:40")
                .with(DISTANCE, "38.6")

        assertEquals("31.9", draft.derived(AVG_SPEED))
    }

    @Test
    fun theRowerDerivesPerFiveHundredMetres() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.ROWER)
                .with(DURATION, "8:24")
                .with(DISTANCE, "2000")

        assertEquals("2:06", draft.derived(AVG_PACE))
    }

    @Test
    fun maxBelowAvgIsAnError() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)
                .with(DURATION, "33:12")
                .with(AVG_HEART_RATE, "148")
                .with(MAX_HEART_RATE, "139")

        assertEquals("max heart rate is below average", draft.errors()[MAX_HEART_RATE])
    }

    @Test
    fun rowerCadenceOutOfRangeNamesTheRange() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.ROWER)
                .with(DURATION, "8:24")
                .with(AVG_CADENCE, "8")

        assertEquals("between 10 and 60 spm", draft.errors()[AVG_CADENCE])
    }

    @Test
    fun anErrorShowsOnlyOnceTheFieldWasLeft() {
        val draft =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)
                .with(DURATION, "33:12")
                .with(AVG_CADENCE, "300")

        assertEquals("between 1 and 250 spm", draft.errors()[AVG_CADENCE])
        assertNull(draft.shownError(AVG_CADENCE))
        assertEquals("between 1 and 250 spm", draft.left(AVG_CADENCE).shownError(AVG_CADENCE))
    }

    @Test
    fun durationPrefillsFromTheClockRoundedDown() {
        val started = workout(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN, status = WorkoutStatus.IN_PROGRESS, startedAt = Instant.parse("2026-10-16T18:31:00Z"))

        val draft = CardioLogDraft.fresh(started, Instant.parse("2026-10-16T19:12:06.900Z"))

        assertEquals("41:06", draft.text(DURATION))
    }

    @Test
    fun aSavedLogFillsTheDraft() {
        val saved =
            CardioLog(
                durationSeconds = 4360,
                distance = CardioDistance(5.02, km),
                avgHeartRate = 148,
                maxHeartRate = 171,
                avgCadence = 170,
                elevationGain = 40,
                calories = 512,
                effort = 6,
                derivedAvgPaceSeconds = 869,
            )

        val draft = CardioLogDraft.of(workout(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN, status = WorkoutStatus.FINISHED, log = saved, notes = "hilly"))

        assertEquals("1:12:40", draft.text(DURATION))
        assertEquals("5.02", draft.text(DISTANCE))
        assertEquals("", draft.text(AVG_PACE))
        assertEquals("14:29", draft.derived(AVG_PACE))
        assertEquals("148", draft.text(AVG_HEART_RATE))
        assertEquals("171", draft.text(MAX_HEART_RATE))
        assertEquals("170", draft.text(AVG_CADENCE))
        assertEquals(6, draft.effort)
        assertEquals("hilly", draft.note)
    }

    @Test
    fun theRequestCarriesTypedFieldsOnly() {
        val run =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.OUTDOOR_RUN)
                .with(DURATION, "33:12")
                .with(DISTANCE, "5.02")
                .with(AVG_HEART_RATE, "150")
                .copy(effort = 6, note = "hilly")

        val request = run.toRequest()

        assertEquals(1992, request.durationSeconds)
        assertEquals(CardioDistance(5.02, km), request.distance)
        assertEquals(150, request.avgHeartRate)
        assertEquals(6, request.effort)
        assertNull(request.avgPaceSeconds)
        assertNull(request.avgSpeed)

        val rower =
            draftOf(CardioActivity.ROWER)
                .with(DURATION, "8:24")
                .with(DISTANCE, "7120")

        assertEquals(CardioDistance(7120.0, DistanceUnit.M), rower.toRequest().distance)
    }

package com.gymie.shared.cardio

import com.gymie.shared.cardio.CardioLogField.*
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * What a cardio workout is done on (KAN-936 design §9, §11): the [kinds] a workout of it may be
 * labelled with, in §9's order with Custom last, and the target [metrics] its steps may carry —
 * both the backend's `CardioActivity` sets verbatim. [label] is the picker's name, [withArticle] the
 * form the shorthand's error copy reads ("incline isn't a target on an outdoor run").
 */
@Serializable
enum class CardioActivity(
    val label: String,
    val withArticle: String,
    val kinds: List<CardioKind>,
    val metrics: Set<CardioMetric>,
) {
    OUTDOOR_RUN(
        "Outdoor run",
        "an outdoor run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE, CardioMetric.CADENCE),
    ),
    TREADMILL_RUN(
        "Treadmill run",
        "a treadmill run",
        runKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    OUTDOOR_RIDE(
        "Outdoor ride",
        "an outdoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    INDOOR_RIDE(
        "Indoor ride",
        "an indoor ride",
        rideKinds(),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.SPEED, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ELLIPTICAL(
        "Elliptical",
        "an elliptical",
        listOf(CardioKind.STEADY, CardioKind.INTERVALS, CardioKind.HILLS, CardioKind.CUSTOM),
        setOf(CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),

    /** Metric whatever the workout's unit: pace per 500 m, every distance in metres (KAN-936 `rower-is-metric`). */
    ROWER(
        "Rower",
        "a rower",
        listOf(
            CardioKind.STEADY_STATE,
            CardioKind.INTERVALS,
            CardioKind.PYRAMID,
            CardioKind.SPRINTS,
            CardioKind.TEST_2K,
            CardioKind.CUSTOM,
        ),
        setOf(CardioMetric.PACE, CardioMetric.CADENCE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE, CardioMetric.POWER, CardioMetric.HEART_RATE),
    ),
    ;

    val isRide: Boolean get() = this == OUTDOOR_RIDE || this == INDOOR_RIDE

    /** The log fields this activity's log sheet draws, in sheet order (the backend's `logFields` sets). */
    val logFields: List<CardioLogField>
        get() =
            when (this) {
                OUTDOOR_RUN -> {
                    listOf(
                        DURATION,
                        DISTANCE,
                        AVG_PACE,
                        ELEVATION_GAIN,
                        AVG_HEART_RATE,
                        MAX_HEART_RATE,
                        AVG_CADENCE,
                        CALORIES,
                        EFFORT,
                        NOTE,
                    )
                }

                TREADMILL_RUN -> {
                    listOf(DURATION, DISTANCE, AVG_PACE, AVG_HEART_RATE, MAX_HEART_RATE, CALORIES, EFFORT, NOTE)
                }

                OUTDOOR_RIDE -> {
                    listOf(
                        DURATION,
                        DISTANCE,
                        AVG_SPEED,
                        ELEVATION_GAIN,
                        AVG_HEART_RATE,
                        MAX_HEART_RATE,
                        AVG_CADENCE,
                        AVG_POWER,
                        CALORIES,
                        EFFORT,
                        NOTE,
                    )
                }

                INDOOR_RIDE -> {
                    listOf(
                        DURATION,
                        DISTANCE,
                        AVG_SPEED,
                        AVG_HEART_RATE,
                        MAX_HEART_RATE,
                        AVG_CADENCE,
                        AVG_POWER,
                        CALORIES,
                        EFFORT,
                        NOTE,
                    )
                }

                ELLIPTICAL -> {
                    listOf(DURATION, DISTANCE, AVG_HEART_RATE, MAX_HEART_RATE, AVG_CADENCE, CALORIES, EFFORT, NOTE)
                }

                ROWER -> {
                    listOf(
                        DURATION,
                        DISTANCE,
                        AVG_PACE,
                        AVG_POWER,
                        AVG_HEART_RATE,
                        MAX_HEART_RATE,
                        AVG_CADENCE,
                        CALORIES,
                        EFFORT,
                        NOTE,
                    )
                }
            }
}

private fun runKinds() =
    listOf(
        CardioKind.EASY,
        CardioKind.RECOVERY,
        CardioKind.LONG,
        CardioKind.TEMPO,
        CardioKind.INTERVALS,
        CardioKind.FARTLEK,
        CardioKind.HILLS,
        CardioKind.PROGRESSION,
        CardioKind.RACE,
        CardioKind.CUSTOM,
    )

private fun rideKinds() =
    listOf(
        CardioKind.ENDURANCE,
        CardioKind.RECOVERY,
        CardioKind.TEMPO,
        CardioKind.SWEET_SPOT,
        CardioKind.THRESHOLD,
        CardioKind.VO2_MAX,
        CardioKind.SPRINTS,
        CardioKind.CLIMBS,
        CardioKind.CADENCE_DRILLS,
        CardioKind.CUSTOM,
    )

/** A workout's label and starter (KAN-936 §9, `kind-is-label-plus-template`); [label] as §9's table writes it. */
@Serializable
enum class CardioKind(
    val label: String,
) {
    EASY("Easy"),
    RECOVERY("Recovery"),
    LONG("Long"),
    TEMPO("Tempo"),
    INTERVALS("Intervals"),
    FARTLEK("Fartlek"),
    HILLS("Hills"),
    PROGRESSION("Progression"),
    RACE("Race"),
    ENDURANCE("Endurance"),
    SWEET_SPOT("Sweet spot"),
    THRESHOLD("Threshold"),
    VO2_MAX("VO2 max"),
    SPRINTS("Sprints"),
    CLIMBS("Climbs"),
    CADENCE_DRILLS("Cadence drills"),
    STEADY("Steady"),
    STEADY_STATE("Steady state"),
    PYRAMID("Pyramid"),
    TEST_2K("2k test"),
    CUSTOM("Custom"),
}

/** A step target's metric, in the backend's order — the order a step's targets are parsed and printed in. */
@Serializable
enum class CardioMetric {
    PACE,
    SPEED,
    HEART_RATE,
    POWER,
    CADENCE,
    INCLINE,
    RESISTANCE,
}

@Serializable
enum class CardioStepType {
    WARM_UP,
    WORK,
    RECOVER,
    REST,
    COOL_DOWN,
}

/** A distance's own unit (KAN-936 `numbers-stored-as-typed`); a workout's unit is [KM] or [MI]. */
@Serializable
enum class DistanceUnit(
    val metres: Double,
) {
    M(1.0),
    KM(1000.0),
    MI(1609.344),
}
